channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Workday breaks every job into tasks: Work Intelligence debuts at Rising 2026
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Workday introduced Work Intelligence on October 13, 2026, at Workday Rising 2026 in Las Vegas: it breaks each job into its underlying tasks, ties them to skills via the Skills Cloud — used by 3,450+ customers, built on a 75,000-skill ontology — and shows leaders where AI can help, what it should augment, and what has to stay human. Available now to early-access Workday HCM customers.

item.title: NetBox goes native inside NVIDIA’s AI datacenter OS: partnerships with NVIDIA and Grafana, plus an MCP server for agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At its first NetBox Evolve conference on October 13, NetBox Labs announced partnerships with NVIDIA and Grafana Labs, plus a generally available MCP server and pre-built agents for agentic infrastructure operations — the ‘central intelligence layer’ for AI datacenter buildouts used by 90%+ of top neoclouds.

item.title: NVIDIA declares RTX Spark 'all systems go': Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B lands Oct 15, PAIR exits beta
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: NVIDIA declared the RTX Spark software stack 'all systems go' three days before Friday's laptop launch: the open-weights Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B agent model arrives October 15, the free Personal AI Router (PAIR) exits beta today, and llama.cpp ships a native Windows app.

item.title: Loops raises $3.5M from a16z Speedrun to build one AI layer for all of e-commerce
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Loops, a San Francisco startup building AI for brands and retailers, has raised a $3.5M seed round led by Andreessen Horowitz's a16z Speedrun to build an 'AI operating system for commerce' — one shared AI layer running product search, shopping assistance, customer support, catalog enrichment and virtual try-on.

item.title: Apple brings Siri AI home: the $299 HomeView hub leads a four-product smart-home launch
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Apple unveiled its first smart-home hub, HomeView, at its October 13 “Welcome home” event — alongside a HomePod mini 2, a new Apple TV 4K and an Apple Home Collection of LG and Schneider accessories. Siri AI is the thread through all four.

item.title: Turn any website into LLM-ready Markdown: a hands-on guide to Crawl4AI
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: crawl4ai (unclecode/crawl4ai, past 85,000 GitHub stars, Apache-2.0) is an open-source web crawler that turns any website into clean, LLM-ready Markdown. This tutorial installs it, scrapes your first page, and extracts structured JSON with zero LLM calls.

item.title: Waters plugs Claude into the lab: AI Link brings Anthropic’s MCP to instruments and joins the Model Hardware Standard
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Announced today, Waters AI Link brings Anthropic’s Model Context Protocol to waters_connect software so scientists can direct LC-MS instruments through Claude and AI agents — and Waters has joined Anthropic’s Model Hardware Standard research program. Early access now, general availability in November.

item.title: Nvidia’s China AI-chip share falls to 34% as Huawei closes the gap — new IDC data
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Nvidia’s share of China’s data-centre AI chip market fell to 34% in the first half of 2026 while Huawei climbed to 28%, according to IDC data seen by Reuters — the clearest sign yet that US export controls are remaking the world’s second-largest AI hardware market.

item.title: Drylab AI raises $3M seed to build autonomous ‘AI scientists’ for biopharma labs
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Drylab AI has raised US$3 million in seed funding led by Vertex Ventures Southeast Asia & India. The Singapore startup's agents take ownership of entire computational research workflows — from hypothesis to verified result — running inside the customer's own infrastructure.

item.title: Accelya launches FLX Recover: agentic AI that coordinates airline disruption recovery without ripping out the PSS
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Announced October 13 at the World Aviation Festival in Lisbon, FLX Recover uses specialized AI agents — powered by Accelya's FLX AIViator and Amazon Bedrock AgentCore — to rebook and care for disrupted passengers from the first delay signal to resolution, working inside the systems airlines already run.

item.title: sAInaptic raises £1M seed to bring AI grading to apprenticeship assessments
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: sAInaptic raised £1M in a pre-money seed round to extend its AI auto-marking into apprenticeship assessments, reporting under 1% deviation from human grades.

item.title: TRM Labs launches Ardence: an AI-native investigation platform for the age of AI-enabled crime
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: TRM Labs launched Ardence, an AI-native investigation platform that applies expert tradecraft across a 60+ partner data network to fight fraud, cybercrime, child exploitation, and terrorism financing.

item.title: Stop shipping AI slop video: a hands-on guide to motionmaxxing
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: motionmaxxing (Tejashmakwana/motionmaxxing, past 300 GitHub stars, Apache-2.0) is an agent skill that turns AI slop videos into films that look made by a motion designer: a 10-step protocol, 12 measured eases, and scripted quality gates G0–G5. This tutorial installs it, renders your first kinetic-type sting, and shows how the gates catch the defaults.

item.title: GFI builds Eloquens AI into KerioConnect: an AI email assistant for 30,000 self-hosted mail servers
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: GFI Software announced that Eloquens AI is now built directly into KerioConnect — an AI email assistant for the 30,000 organizations that run their own mail servers, with no cloud migration required.

item.title: DXC × LangChain: governed AI agents for mission-critical IT, with 95% faster incident resolution
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: DXC Technology is partnering with LangChain to bring governed agentic AI to mission-critical IT environments. Its OASIS platform, already in production, has cut incident resolution time by 95% across 500 measured use cases — while keeping humans in the loop.

item.title: Omron bets $675M on physical AI: Japan’s automation giant buys Vermont’s OnLogic
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Japan’s Omron will pay $675 million in cash for industrial-PC maker OnLogic and its parent Interlogic, aiming to turn its control-equipment business into a “physical AI company.” Closing is expected around January 2027.

item.title: Meta launches Muse Wonder, its first true frontier models — and keeps the strongest one inside Muse Code
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta introduced the Muse Wonder series on Monday — Muse Wonder and Muse Wonder Full — calling them its most capable models to date. The bigger model is reserved for Muse Code subscribers; the smaller one hits the API at $4/$20 per million tokens.

item.title: Anthropic's red team: small AI models 'months away' from self-replicating on smart TVs and ovens
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: In research published Monday, Anthropic's Frontier Red Team ran a 26B open-weight model across fifteen $55 Android TV boxes — and projects small models could manage the full self-replication chain by the end of 2026.

item.title: Meta and Google turn back to Nvidia's network: Spectrum-6 for 100K-GPU factories, Falcon Transport on BlueField
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: At the OCP Global Summit in San Jose on October 12, Nvidia disclosed that Meta is adopting its Spectrum-6 102.4Tb/s Ethernet switches to build 100,000-GPU Vera Rubin AI factories, while Google will support Falcon Transport on future ConnectX-10 SuperNICs and BlueField DPUs — even as both hyperscalers keep designing chips to escape Nvidia's grip.

item.title: Turn your coding assistant into a full video studio: hands-on with OpenMontage
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenMontage (calesthio/OpenMontage, past 67,000 GitHub stars, AGPL-3.0) turns your AI coding assistant into an agentic video production studio: 12 pipelines, 100+ tools, and a real-footage documentary path. This tutorial installs it, renders the zero-key demo, and directs your first video — no API keys required.

item.title: Tencent heads back to the bond market for $5B — and tells investors the money is for AI chips
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Tencent told fixed-income investors Monday that a planned ~$5 billion bond offering will finance AI-related capital expenditure — mostly chip purchases — as its AI and computing capex surges 176% year-on-year.

item.title: Capgemini: 68% of carmakers run agentic AI in product development — only 5% can govern it
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: A Capgemini Research Institute survey of 800 automotive executives finds agentic AI surging through product development — but only 5% of organizations report mature AI governance.

item.title: Ex-Plaud exec raises $26M for Ambi, an AI that listens to you all day — disclosure is on you
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Mistlabs, founded by former Plaud executive Peter Mo, raised $26 million led by Luminous Ventures and Huaqin to launch Ambi — iPhone, Mac and Apple Watch apps that keep listening through your day and act during meetings, not just after. The catch: telling the people around you they're being recorded is the user's job.

item.title: Z.ai launches GLM-Legal: a legal-domain agent on GLM-5.3-Flash that hits 19.2% on Harvey LAB
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Z.ai has launched GLM-Legal, a legal-domain agentic model built on its lightweight GLM-5.3-Flash foundation. The company reports a 19.2% all-pass rate on Harvey's LAB benchmark of real-world law firm workflows across 24 practice areas, 12.5 points above its base model, and says it matches frontier closed-source models on LegalBench and PLawBench — with beta access gated behind an application form.

item.title: Matter Machine raises £4M: Liverpool's AI materials-discovery spin-out lands Oxford Nanopore's co-founder
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Matter Machine, an AI-driven materials discovery spin-out from the University of Liverpool, closed an oversubscribed £4 million pre-Series A on October 12, 2026 — the largest raise by a newly formed Liverpool spin-out — and brought in Oxford Nanopore co-founder Dr Gordon Sanghera to lead commercialisation.
